## R


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(haven)           # import Stata data and labels
library(dplyr)           # data manipulation
library(marginaleffects) # predictions and marginal effects
library(questionr)       # odds ratios

# Health and Retirement Study 2006
hrs <- read_dta("https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/hrs06.dta")

# Treat binary/nominal variables as factors using their value labels
hrs <- hrs |>
  mutate(black = as_factor(black), woman = as_factor(woman), ed4cat = as_factor(ed4cat))

diabmod <- glm(diabetes ~ age + black + bmi + woman + ed4cat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = hrs)
odds.ratio(diabmod, level = .95, digits = 4)
```

## Compute MEM and OR for effect of race

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}
## Stata

```{.stata-run}
. * Compute OR for effect of race
. est restore diabmod
(results diabmod are active now)

. mtable, at(black=(0 1)) decimal(7) atmeans post

Expression: Pr(diabetes), predict()

           |    black     Pr(y)
 ----------+-------------------
         1 |        0  0.1668597
         2 |        1  0.2479810

Specified values of covariates

           |                            1.          2.        3.        4.
           |      age       bmi     woman      ed4cat    ed4cat    ed4cat
 ----------+-------------------------------------------------------------
   Current |   68.798   27.8424   .583059    .3410534    .21185   .217023

. mlincom 2 - 1 // MEM

             |   lincom    pvalue        ll        ul 
-------------+---------------------------------------
           1 |    0.081     0.000     0.063     0.099 

. 
. di 0.2479810 / (1 - 0.2479810) // Odds when black = 1
.32975364

. di 0.1668597 / (1 - 0.1668597) // Odds when black = 0
.20027803

. di %6.4f .32975364 / .20027803 // Odds ratio
1.6465

```

## R


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Compute OR for effect of race: predictions with other variables at means/modes
prs_black <- predictions(diabmod, newdata = datagrid(black = c("White", "Black")))
prs_black
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

``` r-output

 black Estimate Pr(>|z|)     S 2.5 % 97.5 %
 White    0.157   <0.001   Inf 0.147  0.168
 Black    0.235   <0.001 308.6 0.215  0.256

Type: invlink(link)
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
comparisons(diabmod, variables = "black", newdata = "mean") # MEM
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

``` r-output

 Estimate Std. Error    z Pr(>|z|)    S 2.5 % 97.5 %
   0.0778    0.00909 8.56   <0.001 56.3  0.06 0.0956

Term: black
Type: response
Comparison: Black - White
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
odds_black <- prs_black$estimate / (1 - prs_black$estimate)
odds_black                   # Odds when black = 0 and black = 1
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

``` r-output
[1] 0.1866140 0.3072561
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
odds_black[2] / odds_black[1] # Odds ratio
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

``` r-output
[1] 1.64648
```


:::
:::


:::

::: {.callout-note icon="false" appearance="simple"}
Reminder---odds (Ω) are just a transformation of a probability (π):

$$\Omega = \frac{\pi}{1 - \pi}$$
:::
